english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is included or forms part of a whole.
This is the all-purpose verb for saying that a job, plan, or thing includes something.
Use this as the all-purpose verb for saying that something includes particular parts or elements.
This is the all-purpose choice for including things within a scope, including a complete range.

english.meaning: include as part of a whole
english.note: Use this when something embodies something else by including it as one part of a larger whole.
Use this when explicitly listing something as a component or included part.

examples.english: This set meal will include a drink and dessert.
examples.traditional: 呢個套餐包括飲品同甜品。
